problems: compiler: tools/compile_dossiers.py decide() R2 (line ~909, ab = (b, a) in self.succ and y >= self.start[b]) lets a successor win from its own start year even when it is the older state: sumerian-city-states (-3400) is listed as successor of first-dynasty-of-ur (-2600..-2340) and so beats Ur's city for its whole life; rulings cannot override R2. Worked around with events/0 (a gain from sumerian-city-states of Ur's 40 km circle minus Lagash's 40 km circle, 17 cells). The same pattern probably recurs wherever a dossier lists a longer-lived collective as its successor; the dossier's own intent (successor takes the land at the dissolve year) would be met by applying R2 only from the predecessor's end year, or when the successor starts after the predecessor.

first-dynasty-of-ur's 40 km circle (19 cells) overlaps lagash's 40 km circle by 2 cells; the patch region cuts them so that Lagash's -2520 founding keeps its 19 cells (Ur gets 17). The Ur radius is the dossier's own choice (its keyframe note says so), not a sourced figure.
